accuracy_notes: Full, outline, reserved matters, condition discharge and amendments were kept distinct.
Permitted development and prior approval were not treated as unconditional permission.
Lawful development certificates were not represented as fresh discretionary planning permissions.
National grant and PDR acceptance rates were not converted into parcel probabilities.
Enforcement and appeal stages were not converted into final planning outcomes.
No parcel planning status, implementation status or Future Growth score was fabricated.
